title: エリザベス女王杯の後に・お前は、

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet acquits herself admirably in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her next race will be the medium-distance senior G1 Osaka Hai, where she confidently states that she'll shine the brightest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka, who was watching the race, quietly acknowledges her rival's impressive performance.
